clarity.reason: 分项清楚、术语随即解释，结尾简洁归纳方法的挑战对象与伦理目的。
clarity.evidence: He sought clear, general definitions and tested them against particular cases.

reason: 回答简洁而完整，准确呈现苏格拉底通过对话检验信念的方法及其作用，无实质性缺陷。

If relevant content is missing, evidence may be an empty string and reason must describe the missing content. List material errors in critical_errors, otherwise an empty list; needs_review=true when genuine uncertainty needs human checking. Give a brief Chinese overall reason. Return only schema-conforming JSON; aggregate is computed locally.
